raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer made the first mistake by failing to identify the correct maternal grandmother of Constantine Palaiologos (son of Andronikos II) due to confusion between multiple historical figures named Anna of Hungary. The WebSurfer did not sufficiently disambiguate whether the Anna being referenced was the Byzantine Empress (daughter of Stephen V of Hungary and Elizabeth the Cuman) or another Anna of Hungary (e.g., the daughter of Béla IV). This led to ambiguity and incorrect assumptions in subsequent steps, as the Planner built upon incomplete or conflicting information provided by the WebSurfer.
